title: Social Studio desktop Story job format 1
description: Timing is milliseconds. Paths are local, relative to the job. Semantic rules: ordered nonoverlapping cues inside duration; cover inside duration; local paths only. Duration window is the phase 1 product constraint, not a platform maximum. Duration must contain a whole number of frames at the profile fps. Caption text is nonempty, single-line and cannot contain SRT arrow syntax. Media are PNG/JPEG and RIFF/WAVE files; decoding is verified at render time. Cue boundaries resolve using the pinned renderer expression round((milliseconds / 1000) * fps), preserving IEEE-754 operation order; each cue must occupy at least one frame after this conversion. Supply exactly one image (for the entire job) or an ordered scenes list. Scenes use hard cuts; each duration must contain whole frames and the sum must equal durationMs. Captions and cover use the global job timeline. The twelve-scene limit is an authoring constraint, not a platform limit.
